release_notes: Build 141 consolidates external credentials into one Settings → API & Connections page while keeping the existing encrypted credential storage.
Adds individual live Test buttons and Test all connections for OpenAI, Pixabay, Pexels, YouTube Data API, YouTube OAuth, Facebook Page and Instagram.
Instagram settings now link directly to Meta's Instagram Login setup and identify the connected professional account with a lightweight read-only check.
Connection tests are asynchronous and read-only: they do not upload, publish, delete or modify social content.
